title: Closeout summary: S04T05 - Expose directive obligations via daemon and agent-runtime
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented registry-backed directive obligations for agent-runtime and daemon surfaces. Added compileAgentRuntimeDirectiveObligations for work, session, closeout, health, and handoff contexts; daemon status/watch now expose agentDirectives and directiveObligations; docs and focused tests cover the behavior.

Close reason: S04T05 criteria satisfied: daemon and agent-runtime callers can request registry-backed directive bundles for work, session, closeout, health, and handoff contexts without CLI-specific coupling.
